rules: Effects of one assumption are evaluated simultaneously against the row as it was before that assumption; assumptions apply in the order listed here. Formulas use the language of docs/data-standard.md §6.

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio of the disc at 3.6 µm, Υ_disk
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight in the disc stands for

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251), 'as suggested by stellar population models'; Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251) abstract: 0.2 as suggested by the DiskMass survey; 0.7 the mean maximum-disk limit in bright galaxies

aeg-d-sparc/v2.default_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251), 'as suggested by stellar population models'; Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1
aeg-d-sparc/v2.range_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251) abstract: 0.2 as suggested by the DiskMass survey; 0.7 the mean maximum-disk limit in bright galaxies

range_basis.min: 0.2, as suggested by the DiskMass survey (arXiv:1606.09251 abstract)
range_basis.max: 0.7, the mean maximum-disk limit in bright galaxies (arXiv:1606.09251 abstract)

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio of the bulge at 3.6 µm, Υ_bul
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight in the central bulge stands for

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1; equals 1.4 Υ_disk at the disc default (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: 1.4 × the disc range, following the source's adopted relation Υ_bul = 1.4 Υ_disk, 'as suggested by SPS models' (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)

aeg-d-sparc/v2.default_ref: Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1; equals 1.4 Υ_disk at the disc default (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)
aeg-d-sparc/v2.range_ref: 1.4 × the disc range, following the source's adopted relation Υ_bul = 1.4 Υ_disk, 'as suggested by SPS models' (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)

range_basis.min: 1.4 × 0.2, the source's relation Υ_bul = 1.4 Υ_disk (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)

assumptions.name_technical: Galaxy distance, within its published one-sigma error
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the galaxy is

parameter.unit: published one-sigma errors from the catalogue distance

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 distance D and error e_D, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_D, per galaxy. At fixed angle R scales with D, so g_obs = V²/R scales as 1/D; g_bar is distance independent (arXiv:1610.08981 §II.1.2)

aeg-d-sparc/v2.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 distance D and error e_D, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v2.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_D, per galaxy. At fixed angle R scales with D, so g_obs = V²/R scales as 1/D; g_bar is distance independent (arXiv:1610.08981 §II.1.2)

assumptions.name_technical: Disc inclination, within its published one-sigma error
assumptions.name_plain: How tilted the disc is as we see it

parameter.unit: published one-sigma errors from the catalogue inclination

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 inclination and error, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_Inc, per galaxy. V_obs scales as 1/sin i, so g_obs scales as 1/sin² i; the source's g_bar error carries no inclination term (arXiv:1610.08981 eq. 2 and §II.1.2)

aeg-d-sparc/v2.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 inclination and error, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v2.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_Inc, per galaxy. V_obs scales as 1/sin i, so g_obs scales as 1/sin² i; the source's g_bar error carries no inclination term (arXiv:1610.08981 eq. 2 and §II.1.2)

assumptions.name_technical: Helium correction to atomic-hydrogen gas mass
assumptions.name_plain: Allowance for helium mixed in with the hydrogen gas

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 2 note 2; arXiv:1606.09251 §III.3: total gas mass 1.33 M_HI

aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.default_ref: Register default (Lelli et al. 2016, arXiv:1606.09251 §III.3, read at source); D-034, D-058
aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.note: Not adjustable until a published range is read (D-034).

aeg-d-sparc/v2.default_ref: SPARC Table 2 note 2; arXiv:1606.09251 §III.3: total gas mass 1.33 M_HI

aeg-d-dwarfs/v2.note: Not adjustable until a published range is read (D-034).

assumptions.name_technical: Deprojection of the lensing excess surface density to g_obs: singular isothermal sphere, g_obs = 4 G ΔΣ
assumptions.name_plain: How the light-bending measurement is turned into a pull at a given distance

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v1.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) §2.2, eq. 7; validated by the authors against a piece-wise power-law method assuming only spherical symmetry (App. B, §4.4)

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v2.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) §2.2, eq. 7; validated by the authors against a piece-wise power-law method assuming only spherical symmetry (App. B, §4.4)

assumptions.name_technical: Hot gas around isolated galaxies: isothermal, within 100 h70⁻¹ kpc, mass equal to the stellar mass
assumptions.name_plain: An allowance for hot, hard-to-see gas around galaxies

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v1.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) Fig. 4 caption and §5.2: 'only a rough order of magnitude estimate'; applies to the kids_bright_hotgas sample only

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v2.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) Fig. 4 caption and §5.2: 'only a rough order of magnitude estimate'; applies to the kids_bright_hotgas sample only

assumptions.name_technical: X-ray hydrostatic bias b, with M_true = M_hydrostatic / (1 − b)
assumptions.name_plain: How much of the gas's support against the pull is missed by assuming pressure balance from heat alone

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00034): non-thermal pressure about 6 % at R500 and 10 % at R200; hydrostatic masses 'require little correction'. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.range_ref: Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00034): 1 − b = 0.85 ± 0.05 for Planck SZ-based masses; 0.2 is its one-sigma edge. D-022

aeg-d-xcop/v2.default_ref: Eckert et al. 2022 (arXiv 2205.01110v1) l. 502, sentence (2): "we conclude that our measurements are mildly biased ($<10\%$) out to $R_{500}$"; the source applies no correction. Part B item 7; D-105 O3
aeg-d-xcop/v2.range_ref: Eckert et al. 2022 l. 502: "X-COP hydrostatic masses are 10-15\% lower than weak lensing estimates" (b ≈ 0.10–0.15) and Eckert 2019's "7\% at $R_{500}$, 10\% at $R_{200}$"; the maximum 0.2 (v1's) covers both. Part B item 7; D-105 O3
aeg-d-xcop/v2.note: b in M_true = M_HSE / (1 − b). l. 502's simulation range "$5-30\%$ at $R_{500}$" exceeds the slider's maximum; l. 539's "$10-20\%$" at R200 is a nonthermal-pressure fraction, recorded in the term notes and not used as b. The terms hse_bias and nonthermal_pressure state the source's sizes.

assumptions.name_technical: Intracluster light: share f of total cluster starlight not counted in the measured stellar masses
assumptions.name_plain: Starlight spread between the galaxies that the star counts leave out

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Ghizzardi et al. 2020 (arXiv:2007.01084): measured stellar masses include the central galaxy and exclude intracluster light. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.range_ref: Span given by Ghizzardi et al. 2020: Zibetti et al. 2005, 10.9 ± 5.0 % within 500 kpc; Zhang et al. 2019, 44 ± 17 % within 1 Mpc (includes the central galaxy, so 0.5 is generous). Assumed to follow the measured stars' radial distribution. D-022

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass of clusters without measured stars: NFW-shaped profile, c = 2.9 relative to r200, normalised by M★/M_gas(<R500) = 0.39 (M500/1e14 M☉)^−0.84
assumptions.name_plain: An estimate of the stars' mass in clusters where they were not measured

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Ettori et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00035) §5; concentration from Lin et al. 2004 (arXiv:astro-ph/0402308); normalisation from Gonzalez et al. 2013; M500 and R200 from Ettori et al. 2019 Table 1. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.note: No slider until Gonzalez et al. 2013 is read at source for the relation's scatter and its treatment of the central galaxy and intracluster light (D-022).

assumptions.name_technical: Spherical symmetry and dynamical equilibrium; half-light-radius mass estimator M(<r½) = 3 σ²_los r½ / G (Wolf et al. 2010)
assumptions.name_plain: The cluster is treated as round and settled, and its stars' motions as balancing its pull

assumptions.name_technical: 3D half-light radius r½ = 4/3 × projected half-light radius R_h
assumptions.name_plain: Turning the half-light size seen on the sky into a size in space

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.note: v2: the 4/3 of v1 made numeric. Used by the uncertainty term deprojection_4_3. Not a slider.

assumptions.name_technical: Light weights and R_h from the King (1966) model fitted by McLaughlin & van der Marel (2005); bin edges inferred from mean radii
assumptions.name_plain: How the cluster's light is spread out, used to weight the motions

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.default_ref: D-036 (ii), D-045, D-047; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (ApJS 161, 304) Table 10 (VizieR models)

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.default_ref: D-036 (ii), D-045, D-047; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (ApJS 161, 304) Table 10 (W0 and r0; VizieR models) and Table 11 (tab:struc, R_h)
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.note: v2: location corrected (step A F7): W0 and r0 are in MvdM Table 10, R_h in Table 11 (tab:struc).

assumptions.name_technical: Distance from horizontal-branch photometry, Harris (1996, 2010 edition)
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the cluster is, from the brightness of a type of star

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.note: No slider yet: Harris gives no per-cluster distance error.

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.default_ref: D-042; Harris 1996 (2010 edition), arXiv 1012.3224v1: M_V(HB) = (0.160 ± 0.033)[Fe/H] + (0.844 ± 0.049) (l. 148), rms 0.11 mag about it (l. 152); calibrated partly with dynamical parallaxes (l. 125–127; D-099 rule 3)
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.note: v2: numeric parameter p = shift in M_V(HB) in mag (default 0). g_obs ∝ 1/D; R_Sun and L_V move together, so g_bar is unchanged (step A F1). Used by uncertainty terms distance_hb_zero_point and distance_hb_scatter. Not a slider (REPRODUCTION.md item 7).

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio Υ_V from population synthesis (Bruzual & Charlot 2003, Chabrier disk IMF), per cluster
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight stands for

parameter.unit: position in the published range: −1 = 0.53 × default, 0 = default, +1 = Salpeter value

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.default_ref: D-039; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 §3 and Table 8 (VizieR clusters, (M/L)1); M_V,sun = 4.85 (their §4.2)
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.range_ref: D-039 item 3. Lower end: 0.53 × the population value, the smallest dissolution factor Q in Kruijssen & Mieske 2009 (arXiv:0903.4683) §2, Table 1 (Q = 0.53–1.00), a range bound only, never a per-cluster default. Upper end: each cluster's BC03 + Salpeter value, McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (M/L)2 (Salpeter 60–75% above Chabrier, their §3). Asymmetric by construction; read at source: docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md.

range_basis.min: Kruijssen & Mieske 2009, smallest Q = 0.53 (loss of low-mass stars by dissolution)
range_basis.max: McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005, (M/L)_V with a Salpeter IMF, per cluster

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.evidence: Direct low-mass IMF evidence read at source (D-039 item 2, docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md): consistent with the Chabrier/Kroupa default; neither source supports a Salpeter-like low-mass IMF in these systems.

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.default_ref: D-039; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 §3 and Table 8 (VizieR clusters, (M/L)1); M_V,sun = 4.85 (their §4.2)
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.range_ref: D-039 item 3. Upper end: each cluster's BC03 + Salpeter value, McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (M/L)2 (Salpeter 60–75% above Chabrier, their §3). Asymmetric by construction; read at source: docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md.

range_basis.min: Kruijssen & Mieske 2009, smallest Q = 0.53 (loss of low-mass stars by dissolution)
range_basis.max: McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005, (M/L)_V with a Salpeter IMF, per cluster

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.evidence: Direct low-mass IMF evidence read at source (D-039 item 2, docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md): consistent with the Chabrier/Kroupa default; neither source supports a Salpeter-like low-mass IMF in these systems.
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.note: v2: location corrected (step A F7): KM09's Q values are in table tab:pred of arXiv v1, not Table 1.

assumptions.name_plain: The galaxy is treated as round and settled, and its stars' motions as balancing its pull

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_plain: Placing the galaxy's brightness at the adopted distance

assumptions.name_technical: Light deflection by the projected mass inside the Einstein radius as in general relativity: M_E = θ_E² c² D_s D_l / (4 G D_ls) (A6S_PRECEDENCE §2.4)
assumptions.name_plain: Light-bending measures the pull of everything inside the ring of the lensed images
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Distances in the flat ΛCDM cosmology stated by the source of each θ_E (H0, Ω_m; Ω_Λ = 1 − Ω_m as printed, D-075 item 4)
assumptions.name_plain: Distances to the lens and the background galaxy from each paper's own expansion model

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.note: Enters M_E and R_E; g_obs/g_bar does not depend on it to first order (D-064 item 4). No slider.

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.default_ref: p = H0_alt / H0_adopted from the term's own pair in km s-1 Mpc-1 (cosmology_h0_snells, cosmology_h0_j0403, cosmology_h0_manga); p0 = 1 is the source's own cosmology. D-094 rule 4; D-104 rule 1; REPRODUCTION.md item 7
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.not_adjustable_reason: the effect of a stated H0 pair; making it a slider needs a ruling
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.note: Enters M_E and R_E. All distances scale as 1/H0 at fixed Ω_m, so g_obs = π G Σ_cr ∝ H0 and R_E ∝ 1/H0, while the stellar g_bar is unchanged (M* ∝ D_L² and R_E² ∝ D_A²): the ratio depends on H0 at first order (D-094, replacing D-064 item 4). No row column enters p. Not a slider.

assumptions.name_technical: Where only a total stellar mass is printed: the fraction inside R_E from the source's own light profile (de Vaucouleurs or Sérsic; aeg.lensing.sersic_projected_fraction), assuming mass follows light (A6S_PRECEDENCE §3.1)

Rows without a top (SNELLS: none read) are not offered the slider (flag imf_top_not_read).

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.range_ref: Top: Salpeter value printed by the same source (R13 Salpeter-BC03; R20 Salpeter), else the source's printed conversion (R29 α = 1.55; R32 α ≈ 1.65, flag salpeter_factor_approx_printed; R30 ÷ 0.61), and for S4TM R30's printed FSPS factor ÷ 0.61 = × 1.64 (D-076 item 2; other printed conversions span 1.55-1.71, reading/gas/adjudication_gas.md §6). range_basis.max: the Salpeter value or printed conversion (A6S_PRECEDENCE §3.2; D-076 item 2)

assumptions.name_technical: Gas inside R_E as fractions of M*(<R_E) at the default IMF: hot X-ray gas default 0.12% (range 0.015-2.5%), cold gas (molecular plus atomic) default 0 (range 0-2%); total 0.12% (0.015-4.5%) (D-076 item 1, option G1)
assumptions.name_plain: How much gas sits inside the ring, compared with the stars

parameter.unit: position in the registered range: −1 = minimum, 0 = default, +1 = maximum (each component)

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.default_ref: D-076 item 1 (option G1): hot default 0.12% = median of 28 same-aperture X-ray gas and stellar measurements of early-type galaxies (25 detected); cold default 0 (molecular: 40 of 56 are limits; atomic: central HI undetected in 85% of high-mass ATLAS3D early-types). gas_term.json; reading/gas/adjudication_gas.md §3-5
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.range_ref: Hot: lowest measured 0.015% to highest measured 2.5%; cold: 0 to 2% (molecular top from a published bound of about 1%, atomic top from a flagged sample bound of about 1%). Radii never rescaled; single-dish beams at half their printed width; non-detections kept as limits (D-076 item 1).

range_basis.min: lowest measured value (hot); zero (cold, allowed by the limits)

effects.formula: g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

g_bar - g_bar_gas_hot - g_bar_gas_cold + g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * ((x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p)) + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p)))

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.note: The five systems whose sources state gas negligible (SNL-0, SNL-1, SNL-2, J1436+4943, J1701+3722) take the same term; the statements are kept as notes (D-076 item 1).

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.default_ref: D-076 item 1 (option G1): hot default 0.12% = median of 28 same-aperture X-ray gas and stellar measurements of early-type galaxies (25 detected); cold default 0 (molecular: 40 of 56 are limits; atomic: central HI undetected in 85% of high-mass ATLAS3D early-types). gas_term.json; reading/gas/adjudication_gas.md §3-5

Radii never rescaled; single-dish beams at half their printed width; non-detections kept as limits (D-076 item 1).

range_basis.min: lowest measured value (hot); zero (cold, allowed by the limits)

effects.formula: x_strong_lensing_g_bar_stars_ref * (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

x_strong_lensing_g_bar_stars_ref * (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

g_bar - g_bar_gas_hot - g_bar_gas_cold + x_strong_lensing_g_bar_stars_ref * ((x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p)) + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p)))

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.note: The five systems whose sources state gas negligible (SNL-0, SNL-1, SNL-2, J1436+4943, J1701+3722) take the same term; the statements are kept as notes (D-076 item 1). v2: G M*(<R_E)/R_E² at the default IMF is read from x_strong_lensing_g_bar_stars_ref (= g_obs × mstar_re_msun / m_e_msun, the same value at every default), so the gas term does not move with H0 or the lens distance and follows θ_E (REPRODUCTION.md item 7). Fractions and range as v1.

assumptions.name_technical: Member-sample σ taken as representative of the light-weighted σ (D-038 1A)

assumptions.name_technical: Ellipticity ε used in the circularised half-light radius R_h = a √(1 − ε)
assumptions.name_plain: How flattened the galaxy looks, used to turn its long-axis size into an average size

aeg-d-dwarfs/v2.parameter_note: p shifts ε on rows with x_dwarfs_eps_used = 1

effects.formula: g_obs * sqrt((1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p0) / (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p))
g_bar_stars * (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p0) / (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p)
g_bar_gas_cold * (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p0) / (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p)
(g_bar_stars + g_bar_gas_cold) * (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p0) / (1 - x_dwarfs_ellipticity - x_dwarfs_eps_used * p)

assumptions.name_plain: How dust dimming relates to dust reddening

assumptions.name_plain: The measured size of the cluster on the sky

assumptions.name_plain: How bright the whole cluster is

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v2.note: L_V ∝ 10^(−0.4 V_t). Used by the term integrated_magnitude. Not a slider.

assumptions.name_plain: A small change in how much mass each unit of starlight stands for

assumptions.name_technical: Baryons as a point mass at the lens centre: g_bar = G M_gal / r², with M_gal the stellar plus cold-gas mass (plus the assumed hot-gas component in the variant)
assumptions.name_plain: The detected matter of each galaxy treated as if it sat at one point

assumptions.name_technical: Einstein radius θ_E as printed; its error moves g_bar and R_E, not g_obs, where M_E is the mass inside the radius of mean convergence 1 (standard §2a rule 7; d ln g_bar / d ln θ_E from the printed light profile)
assumptions.name_plain: The size of the ring of lensed images, which sets how much of the starlight falls inside it
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: the effect of a stated θ_E error; not a slider

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.default_ref: θ_E as printed by each source (v1 values); REPRODUCTION.md rule 5 and item 7

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.note: Used by the terms theta_e, theta_e_ngc6505, lens_model_profile, sie_axis_convention, external_shear and lens_light_subtraction. g_obs is unchanged. Log-linear (first-order) in ln θ_E: adequate at 2 %; at J1701's 10 % the second-order term is not computed. Rows without x_strong_lensing_dlngbar_dlntheta (no printed light profile) are not evaluated: there the effect is not computed (D-104 rule 3).

assumptions.name_technical: Lens distance D_l from the redshift in the source's frame, without a peculiar-velocity correction (g_obs ∝ 1/D_l and R_E ∝ D_l for D_s ≫ D_l; g_bar unchanged)
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the lensing galaxy is, from its redshift

parameter.unit: p = fractional change in D_l (0 = as used)

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: the effect of a stated distance uncertainty; not a slider

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.default_ref: D_l as used by each source (v1 values); REPRODUCTION.md rule 6 and item 7 (D-094; D-104 rule 1)
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.not_adjustable_reason: the effect of a stated distance uncertainty; not a slider
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v2.note: Used by the terms lens_distance_snl0, _snl1, _snl2, lens_distance_ngc6505 and lens_distance_other. g_obs = π G Σ_cr ∝ D_s / (D_l D_ls), which is close to 1/D_l only when D_s ≫ D_l; that holds for the systems sized here (SNELLS, NGC 6505). g_bar is unchanged.

assumptions.name_technical: Hydrostatic equilibrium of the hot gas, used to infer M(<r) from its pressure and density profiles
assumptions.name_plain: The hot gas is assumed to be settled, held up by its own pressure against the pull
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: the method's defining assumption; its bias is the slider xray_hse_bias and the terms hse_bias, nonthermal_pressure

aeg-d-xcop/v2.default_ref: Eckert et al. 2022 (arXiv 2205.01110v1) l. 130 (the HSE equation, \label{eq:hse}); l. 38 ("under the assumption of hydrostatic equilibrium")
aeg-d-xcop/v2.note: E22 l. 373: "the validity of the HSE assumption at large radii is unclear". Part B item 7.
